# GIF to Frames

> Free, private, browser-based tools for splitting animated GIFs into individual image frames.

GIF to Frames is a free browser-based tool for splitting animated GIFs into individual image frames. All decoding, previewing, selection, and export work happens locally in the user's browser. Files are not uploaded to a server. No account, watermark, or installation is required.

## Core capabilities

- Extract animated GIF, WebP, or APNG frames as PNG, JPG, or WebP images.
- Preview every frame with adjustable playback speed.
- Select all frames, a range, the first frame, the last frame, or every Nth frame.
- Filter transparent or duplicate frames.
- Export selected frames as ZIP with a metadata.json file that records frame timing.
- Inspect and export frame delay, size, offset, disposal, and transparency as JSON or CSV.
- Reverse selected frames into a new GIF.
- Create a sprite sheet from selected frames with custom columns and optional frame numbers.
- Combine PNG, JPG, or WebP images into a GIF.

## Tools

- [GIF to Frames](https://www.gif-to-frames.com): Split an animated GIF into PNG, JPG, or WebP frames online, with frame preview, selection, and ZIP export.
- [GIF to PNG Frames](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/gif-to-png-frames/): Convert an animated GIF to lossless PNG frames with transparency preserved.
- [GIF to JPG Frames](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/gif-to-jpg-frames/): Convert an animated GIF to smaller flattened JPG frames with adjustable quality.
- [GIF to WebP Frames](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/gif-to-webp-frames/): Convert an animated GIF to modern compressed WebP frames with transparency.
- [GIF to ZIP Frames](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/gif-to-zip-frames/): Extract GIF frames and download them as one ZIP archive with predictable file names.
- [GIF Frame Metadata](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/gif-frame-metadata/): Inspect frame delay, dimensions, offset, disposal, and transparency, and export as JSON or CSV.
- [GIF to Sprite Sheet](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/gif-to-sprite-sheet/): Arrange selected GIF frames into one PNG sprite sheet for games and UI animation.
- [Frames to GIF](https://www.gif-to-frames.com/frames-to-gif/): Combine PNG, JPG, or WebP images into an animated GIF with custom order, delay, and loops.

## Privacy

All decoding, previewing, selection, and export work happens in the user's browser. Source files do not need to be uploaded. See the privacy policy at https://www.gif-to-frames.com/privacy/.
